items.statement: Ensure drug product containers and closures are not reactive, additive or absorptive in a way that alters the drug's safety, identity, strength, quality or purity beyond official or established requirements.
items.quote: Drug product containers and closures shall not be reactive, additive, or absorptive so as to alter the safety, identity, strength, quality, or purity of the drug beyond the official or established requirements.

items.statement: Ensure container closure systems adequately protect the drug product against foreseeable external factors in storage and use that could cause deterioration or contamination.
items.quote: Container closure systems shall provide adequate protection against foreseeable external factors in storage and use that can cause deterioration or contamination of the drug product.

items.statement: Ensure drug product containers and closures are clean and, where the nature of the drug indicates, sterilized and depyrogenated so they are suitable for their intended use.
items.quote: Drug product containers and closures shall be clean and, where indicated by the nature of the drug, sterilized and processed to remove pyrogenic properties to assure that they are suitable for their intended use.
items.condition: sterilization/depyrogenation where indicated by the nature of the drug

items.statement: Validate the depyrogenation processes used for drug product containers and closures.
items.quote: Such depyrogenation processes shall be validated.

items.statement: Write and follow standards or specifications and test methods for drug product containers and closures and, where indicated, methods for cleaning, sterilizing and depyrogenating them.
items.quote: Standards or specifications, methods of testing, and, where indicated, methods of cleaning, sterilizing, and processing to remove pyrogenic properties shall be written and followed for drug product containers and closures.

items.statement: Have written production and process control procedures designed to assure drug products have the identity, strength, quality and purity they purport or are represented to possess.
items.quote: There shall be written procedures for production and process control designed to assure that the drug products have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess.

items.statement: Make the production and process control procedures include all requirements for production and process controls set out in the regulation.
items.quote: Such procedures shall include all requirements in this subpart.

items.statement: Have production and process control procedures, and any changes to them, drafted, reviewed and approved by the appropriate organizational units and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.
items.quote: These written procedures, including any changes, shall be drafted, reviewed, and approved by the appropriate organizational units and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

items.statement: Follow the written production and process control procedures when carrying out production and process control functions, and document those functions at the time they are performed.
items.quote: Written production and process control procedures shall be followed in the execution of the various production and process control functions and shall be documented at the time of performance.

items.statement: Record and justify any deviation from the written production and process control procedures.
items.quote: Any deviation from the written procedures shall be recorded and justified.

items.statement: Make written production and control procedures cover the charge-in of components (batch formulation, weighing and dispensing, labelling of dispensed containers, second-person checks and addition verification), designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity.
items.quote: Written production and control procedures shall include the following, which are designed to assure that the drug products produced have the identity, strength, quality, and purity they purport or are represented to possess:

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: formulate each batch with the intent of providing not less than 100 percent of the labeled or established amount of active ingredient.
items.quote: The batch shall be formulated with the intent to provide not less than 100 percent of the labeled or established amount of active ingredient.

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: weigh, measure or subdivide components for drug product manufacturing as appropriate.
items.quote: Components for drug product manufacturing shall be weighed, measured, or subdivided as appropriate.

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: if a component is transferred from its original container to another, label the new container with the component name or item code.
items.quote: Component name or item code;
items.condition: component moved to a new container

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: if a component is transferred from its original container to another, label the new container with the receiving or control number.
items.quote: Receiving or control number;
items.condition: component moved to a new container

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: if a component is transferred from its original container to another, label the new container with the weight or measure it holds.
items.quote: Weight or measure in new container;
items.condition: component moved to a new container

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: if a component is transferred from its original container to another, label the new container with the batch it was dispensed for, including that batch's product name, strength and lot number.
items.quote: Batch for which component was dispensed, including its product name, strength, and lot number.
items.condition: component moved to a new container

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: adequately supervise weighing, measuring and subdividing operations for components.
items.quote: Weighing, measuring, or subdividing operations for components shall be adequately supervised.

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: have a second person examine each container of component dispensed to manufacturing to confirm the component was released by the quality control unit (one person suffices where the dispensing is done by qualified automated equipment).
items.quote: The component was released by the quality control unit;
items.condition: each dispensed component container; one person if automated equipment

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: have a second person examine each container of component dispensed to manufacturing to confirm the weight or measure is correct as stated in the batch production records (one person suffices where the dispensing is done by qualified automated equipment).
items.quote: The weight or measure is correct as stated in the batch production records;
items.condition: each dispensed component container; one person if automated equipment

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: have a second person examine each container of component dispensed to manufacturing to confirm the containers are properly identified (one person suffices where the dispensing is done by qualified automated equipment).
items.quote: The containers are properly identified.
items.condition: each dispensed component container; one person if automated equipment

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: where weighing, measuring or subdividing is performed by qualified automated equipment, only one person is needed to confirm QC release, correct weight or measure against the batch record, and proper container identification.
items.quote: If the weighing, measuring, or subdividing operations are performed by automated equipment under § 211.68, only one person is needed to assure paragraphs (c)(1), (c)(2), and (c)(3) of this section.

items.statement: Written production and control procedures include the following, designed to assure the drug products have their purported identity, strength, quality and purity: add each component to the batch by one person with verification by a second person, or, if components are added by qualified automated equipment, have the addition verified by one person.
items.quote: Each component shall either be added to the batch by one person and verified by a second person or, if the components are added by automated equipment under § 211.68, only verified by one person.
items.condition: one-person verification if added by automated equipment

items.statement: Determine actual yields and percentages of theoretical yield at the end of each appropriate phase of manufacturing, processing, packaging or holding of the drug product.
items.quote: Actual yields and percentages of theoretical yield shall be determined at the conclusion of each appropriate phase of manufacturing, processing, packaging, or holding of the drug product.
items.condition: at the conclusion of each appropriate phase

items.statement: Have yield calculations performed by one person and independently verified by a second person, or, if the yield is calculated by qualified automated equipment, independently verified by one person.
items.quote: Such calculations shall either be performed by one person and independently verified by a second person, or, if the yield is calculated by automated equipment under § 211.68, be independently verified by one person.
items.condition: one-person verification if calculated by automated equipment

items.statement: Properly identify all compounding and storage containers, processing lines and major equipment used in producing a batch at all times to show their contents and, when necessary, the batch's phase of processing.
items.quote: All compounding and storage containers, processing lines, and major equipment used during the production of a batch of a drug product shall be properly identified at all times to indicate their contents and, when necessary, the phase of processing of the batch.

items.statement: Identify major equipment with a distinctive identification number or code and record it in the batch production record to show the specific equipment used for each batch.
items.quote: Major equipment shall be identified by a distinctive identification number or code that shall be recorded in the batch production record to show the specific equipment used in the manufacture of each batch of a drug product.

items.statement: Where only one piece of a particular type of equipment exists in the manufacturing facility, the equipment name may be used instead of a distinctive identification number or code.
items.quote: In cases where only one of a particular type of equipment exists in a manufacturing facility, the name of the equipment may be used in lieu of a distinctive identification number or code.
items.condition: only one of that equipment type in the facility
